MORE:
Dear Sir / Madam,

Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform you that Fusion Klassroom Edutech Limited has received and accepted a work order dated 26 October 2026 from a domestic limited company based in Lucknow for Educational Content Licensing and Content Development.

The engagement comprises licensing of e-notes, e-books and e-learning content, together with content development across educational, skill development and vocational courses.  The work order has an indicative value of approximately Rs. 9.10 Crores, excluding GST. The material particulars are provided in Annexure A.

This is for your information and records.

Thanking you
